reviews.text: Texas Service Plumbing just completed a full replacement of all my old cast iron and copper pipes under my 1950’s home. I’ve been using them for a few years unclogging and clearing the old pipes and decided it was time for this to be done. I am very pleased with the quality of work and cost. Everything was completed timely and I was kept in the loop on and updates or changes. I’m a happy customer.

Replaced house bathroom facets (leaking) and stop valves (frozen and outdated). Provided reasonably priced same day excellent service and knowledgeable behavior (aware of proper safety codes) of what you would expect from a Licensed Master Plumber. I would highly recommend Alex for any pluming issues or projects you may have. Additionally, I have already scheduled him to return to my residence next week for further work. So leave him alone until I get my projects done...! j/k.

Seriously though

We called Texas Service Plumbing for a leak repair in a bathroom. Wasn't an emergency but was a major nuisance and needed to be repaired. Alejandro came out the same afternoon and quickly fixed the problem at a very reasonable price. Very thorough clean up after the work was completed. We will definitely give Texas Svc Plumbing our work on future needs. It can be a major stress point when you have to hire someone to make home repairs but this was a great experience and we are totally satisfied.
